id: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003)

facts.text: Captain Jack Sparrow. I'll have the rum, the fish, and whatever's left on your plate, savvy?
facts.why: Not a line Jack says. 'Captain Jack Sparrow' is his introduction at the dock, but the rest is invented. On the island the line people know is 'But why is the rum gone?' (recalled, not read on an opened quote page). The IMDb plot covers the marooning but has no dialogue.
facts.fix: But why is the rum gone?

fix_note.text: Captain Jack Sparrow here. Rum, fish, and whatever is left on your plate, savvy?

vibe.verdict: Rum line, Apple?, the medallion and the crew notes all print, but the plan sheet is a generic galley template and the Tortuga fritters are gone.
ideas: Swap the footer 'Laser issue, fleet standard' for 'Rum rationed. Savvy?'
Swap 'Pirate's rum punch' note for 'The rum is gone. This is the rest.'
Swap the blueprint grid for parchment and a sea map so the paper looks pirate.
Swap 'Barbossa's green apples' note for 'Tastes like ash. Eat it anyway.'
iconic: Why is the rum gone? (signed note, cue on the island)
Worst pirate you've ever heard of (wink)
Compass that doesn't point north, Jack's boat sinking (crew notes)
changed: Signed note now Jack's real rum line
House drink note moved to the cursed crew, since the rum line is now the signed note
